## 2. Corporate Entity: UNAI TECH Pvt Ltd
UNAI TECH Pvt Ltd is an AI-native technology venture builder and systems engineering firm dedicated to building the foundational intelligent layer for next-generation platforms, enterprises, and digital ecosystems.

### Strategic Pillars:
1. **AI-Native Engineering**: Building applications where intelligence is foundational rather than an add-on.
2. **Autonomous Multi-Tenant Systems**: Cloud-native, low-latency microservices powering high-throughput enterprise and consumer workloads.
3. **Applied Cognitive Intelligence**: Transforming institutional data into structured, real-time insights and conversational agents.

## 3. Product Portfolio & Venture Ecosystem

### 01. My Vidyon (https://www.myvidyon.in/)
- **Product Classification**: Autonomous AI Education Ecosystem / All-in-One ERP
- **Target Audience**: Schools, colleges, universities, teachers, students, parents, and administrative staff.
- **Key Modules**: Real-time attendance, fee and financial management, academic timetable generator, parent communication portal, canteen automation, exam analytics, and adaptive student performance metrics.
- **Value Proposition**: India's First All-in-One Education ERP platform designed to unify all institutional stakeholders on a single seamless interface.

### 02. PostsApp (https://postsapp.in/)
- **Product Classification**: Autonomous Citizen Journalism & Political Social Media Platform
- **Target Audience**: Citizens, political analysts, local journalists, grassroots communities, and global news readers.
- **Key Capabilities**: Real-time trending civic discussions, zero-censorship authentic citizen discovery, localized verified journalism, and creator reward monetization.
- **Value Proposition**: Reclaiming citizen voice and providing transparent, authentic community discourse.

### 03. Vidyo AI (https://unaitech.com)
- **Product Classification**: Cognitive Neural Engine & Conversational Learning Platform
- **Key Capabilities**: Document intelligence, instant book/PDF comprehension, interactive 24/7 AI tutor, automatic summarization, and customized quiz generation.
- **Value Proposition**: Transforming static study materials and documents into dynamic, conversational knowledge assistants.

### 04. UNAI 11 / UEOS (https://unaitech.com)
- **Product Classification**: Unified Enterprise Operating System (UEOS)
- **Key Capabilities**: IT service desk automation, infrastructure monitoring, HR & finance workflows, agile project management, real-time KPI dashboards, and enterprise agentic workflows.
- **Value Proposition**: One system. Every operation. Limitless growth.
